title: Stable blowup for the defocusing Schrödinger equation

result.label: Stable blowup for the defocusing Schrödinger equation
result.statement: For a sufficiently large odd nonlinearity power, constructs a nonempty open set of initial data in H^k( T^ 12 ), with k > 8, whose solutions of the scalar defocusing nonlinear Schrödinger equation blow up in finite time. Thus finite-time blowup is stable under Sobolev perturbations in this supercritical regime.
